Hero.dc.html.title: Hero in 3D: lost to clear (press Play, move the pointer)

heroSpec.text:
3D hero, motion spec

The feeling is a maze. The picture is not one.

1. Lost: you are inside a dense field of data fragments at every angle and depth. Near ones blur past, far ones fade into fog. The camera drifts and the pointer turns your head.
2. A thread: one line of light crosses the field, fragment to fragment. Everything else dims. The camera steadies.
3. Order: every fragment turns and settles into three levels. Sources at the base, the semantic layer above them, analysis on top. The camera pulls up and out.
4. Clarity: light runs between the levels and the finding arrives.

Scroll version: the camera move is tied to scroll. Each section of the page is one level of the stack, seen closer.

Build: react-three-fiber with instanced slabs, fog, depth of field and bloom. Motion drives the beats and the scroll. Phones and reduced motion get frame 3 as a still.
